target.deadline_policy: Confirm the official deadline before the held-out freeze.

objective: Submit a CVPR paper on auditable, strictly local floorplan editing with a strong oracle-control upper bound and defensible target-free predicted-control operation reliability, without claiming complete-method or cross-benchmark SOTA.
primary_thesis: FloorFlow separates edit reliability from reference reconstruction fidelity: it executes supported local edits, rejects unsupported or ambiguous requests, preserves the declared outside region exactly, and produces structurally plausible plans even when target-free control fidelity remains limited.

scope.editing_split: test503 oracle-control and a separately frozen predicted-control held-out set
allowed_claims: target-free structural reasonableness under predicted controls
supported-operation execution and safe abstention reliability
forbidden_claims: deployable free-text editing without matched evidence

predicted_control_reasonableness.protocol_boundary: For 401/491 single-component footprints, raw and componentwise watertightness are both 1.0. The remaining 90 multi-component footprints fail the standard single-region fpeval rule but reach componentwise watertightness 0.9889.

paired_refinement.ged_interpretation: Higher GED is a disclosed negative diagnostic.

predicted_control_operation_reasonablene.protocol_boundary: The file named residential_predicted_edit_test503_final_v1.json contains prompt rows with split=test. Its legacy summary incorrectly reported split=val191 and test_opened=false. The evaluator metadata writer is fixed. This run cannot serve as the final held-out result.

predicted_control_fidelity_limitations.graph_metrics: The predicted-edit type graph remains far below absolute Node/Edge/GED publication gates on the evaluated validation prompts.
predicted_control_fidelity_limitations.policy: Report fidelity, reasonableness, and operation safety as separate evidence axes. Do not use oracle fidelity to imply predicted-control fidelity.

claim_ladder.claim: Strict-locality and legality are measurable as independent editing axes.
FloorFlow provides a strong oracle-control edit-detection anchor while preserving exact outside content.
Under target-free predicted controls, FloorFlow executes supported typed operations safely, abstains on unsupported requests, and produces structurally plausible plans.
The predicted-control reliability result generalizes to a frozen held-out set.
FloorFlow beats complete HouseMind or establishes RPLAN/full-CAD SOTA.

S0_claim_integrity: Every numeric claim names dataset, split, input controls, evaluator, and deployability.
Oracle, predicted-control, identity, generation, and free-text rows are never pooled.
FP-Eval validity and FEVP five-check validity remain separate.
Raw and functional/componentwise watertightness remain separate.
S1_oracle_anchor: Per-operation Delta-IoU and Delta-MSE match the current source reports.
Matched local baseline and editing-aware control values are frozen.
HouseMind-E remains labeled as cross-dataset context.
S2_predicted_reasonableness: Raw watertightness and the multi-component footprint boundary are reported.
S3_operation_reliability: All supported prompts execute on the declared operation set.
All explicitly unsupported or ambiguous prompts abstain.
Every executed edit preserves outside pixel and room-label content exactly.
Operation-specific semantic success is frozen and evaluated before test.
Abstention coverage and prompt distribution are reported.
S4_heldout_freeze: Configuration, prompt manifest, checkpoints, seeds, thresholds, and evaluator hashes are frozen.
No threshold or model selection changes after opening.
Failed or negative metrics remain in the result package.
S5_external_and_ablation: Raster2Seq local-redraw and editing-aware control are evaluated on matched rows.
Typed, dense, no-gate, no-graph, and matched-compute ablations are reported.
No external leaderboard rank is fabricated.
S6_manuscript_package: Main tables are readable and tied to claims.
Qualitative panels show before, after, edit region, outside diff, and failure cases.
Limitations and negative results are visible in the main paper.
Reproducibility manifest and anonymous supplement pass integrity checks.

tasks.title: Freeze the two-axis submission claim
tasks.acceptance: The paper claim covers edit reliability and structural reasonableness without claiming complete-method SOTA.

tasks.title: Refresh the evidence registry and mark historical metrics
tasks.acceptance: Current claims reference the latest source reports and stale ranges are marked historical.

tasks.title: Create the compact oracle-control CVPR dossier
tasks.acceptance: Main metrics, matched comparisons, mechanism audit, robustness, slices, and source map are in one document.

tasks.title: Create the predicted-control reasonableness dossier
tasks.acceptance: The dossier reports target-free plausibility, raw and functional watertightness, operation execution/abstention, object-delete audits, contamination boundaries, and separate fidelity limitations.

tasks.title: Define and run operation-specific semantic success audits

metrics.room_type_change: Requested room type is realized in the declared region without outside changes.
metrics.room_addition: A valid room instance of the requested type is inserted in the region.
metrics.room_deletion: The targeted room instance is removed or merged without illegal topology.
metrics.opening_delete: The targeted opening family disappears and room labels remain.
metrics.furniture_delete: The targeted furniture family disappears and room labels remain.

tasks.acceptance: Every supported operation has a deterministic semantic-success predicate, coverage count, denominator, and report. Preliminary stale-model results are below the proposed 0.90 threshold, so promotion awaits the updated frozen model.

tasks.title: Freeze the predicted-control validation protocol
tasks.acceptance: Checkpoints, prompt manifest, operation parser, thresholds, evaluator version, tolerances, and statistics are immutable before held-out access.

tasks.title: Open the predicted-control held-out split once
tasks.acceptance: The held-out result reports supported execution, abstention, semantic success, exact locality, validity, plausibility, fidelity, graph diagnostics, and all negative results exactly once.

tasks.title: Run the final evidence integrity audit
tasks.acceptance: All paper numbers trace to hashed source reports; no stale, oracle-derived, or cross-protocol value enters the predicted-control claim.

tasks.title: Refresh matched local and external comparisons
tasks.acceptance: Raster2Seq redraw, editing-aware control, and FloorFlow use matching rows, controls, preprocessing, and evaluator; HouseMind remains context only.

tasks.title: Build reviewer-facing qualitative and failure evidence
tasks.acceptance: Figures show protocol flow, supported execution, safe abstention, exact outside diff, plausible outputs under imperfect controls, and representative failures.

tasks.title: Freeze the main paper tables
tasks.acceptance: The main paper has at most four result tables and every number maps to a frozen report.

tasks.title: Write the complete CVPR manuscript
tasks.acceptance: The manuscript states the research question, formal protocol, method, claims, evidence, related work, limitations, and submission claims without internal artifact paths or engineering-log language.

tasks.title: Run simulated CVPR review and revise
tasks.acceptance: A methodology reviewer, domain reviewer, and devil's advocate each address oracle leakage, exact-locality construction, fidelity limits, abstention coverage, and external comparability.

tasks.title: Prepare reproducibility and artifact package
tasks.acceptance: The package includes code, config, prompt manifests, row schemas, evaluator hashes, checkpoint hashes, environment instructions, and no restricted data or oversized files.

tasks.title: Run final claim, anonymity, and submission checks
tasks.acceptance: PDF compiles, supplementary files open, references resolve, anonymity passes, claims match results, and all mandatory limitations and disclosures are present.

tasks.title: Submit
tasks.acceptance: Submission is complete before the official deadline with the frozen evidence package.

reviewer_risks.response: Keep oracle metrics as an upper bound and pair them with a target-free predicted-control reasonableness and operation-safety table.

reviewer_risks.risk: Exact outside preservation is guaranteed by local composition.
reviewer_risks.response: Present it as an architectural guarantee, then prove audit value through no-gate leakage, Raster2Seq leakage, object-delete checks, and unsupported-edit abstention.
Separate fidelity from validity and operation reliability; report Room IoU and graph failures without weakening the safety claim.
Report support coverage, prompt construction, unsupported categories, abstention rates, and semantic success on every supported operation.
Use HouseMind only as metric context; rely on matched Raster2Seq and editing-aware controls for local comparisons.
Keep graph metrics as secondary diagnostics and report them as a limitation, not a headline.

decision_rules.condition: Predicted semantic audit and held-out safety/reasonableness pass.
decision_rules.decision: Submit the full two-axis reliability paper.

decision_rules.condition: Held-out reasonableness passes but semantic operation success is weak.
decision_rules.decision: Reframe as safe operation execution and abstention, and move semantic fidelity to limitations.
Do not submit the predicted-control claim; fall back to the oracle-control protocol paper or delay.
Keep unavailable entries as N/A and make no external rank claim.

stop_rules: Do not open the predicted held-out split before FP-SUB-05 is frozen.
Do not add a new model head while the operation-success audit is unfinished.
Do not use a proxy improvement to promote a checkpoint without its canonical consumer.
Do not hide raw watertightness behind functional or componentwise diagnostics.
Do not convert abstention into a successful semantic edit.
Do not pool oracle, predicted-control, identity, generation, and free-text rows.
Do not claim complete-method SOTA without executable matched evidence.
open_items: Confirm the official CVPR cycle and deadline.
Freeze the predicted-control held-out prompt manifest and case split.
Set operation-specific semantic-success thresholds before held-out access.
Audit current predicted-control updates and replace stale validation reports if their contracts changed.
Use a fresh unopened held-out split for the final predicted-control claim because the current test manifest has been used for development.
Decide whether the identity fallback remains a main-paper contribution or an appendix result.
